answer: The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. A biathlon club membership with shooting range logs works as the gate: range sessions logged with one club for years. Each of 158 aliases needs its own range logs, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the ocean signal is public, the cipher check is automatic, and 158 aliases cost 158 times what one real agent costs, with the karst trail open to all.
